title: Orchestrator Handoff Block
description: Structured handoff block passed from the orchestrator to a receiving agent. Every handoff MUST satisfy this schema before being sent.

task.description: One-sentence description of the task being handed off

branch.description: Target branch name or 'not yet created'

files_in_scope.description: Files that will be created or modified

constraints.description: AGENTS.md §5 restrictions or other constraints that apply

skills_to_load.description: Skills the receiving agent should load for this task

context_files.description: Files the receiving agent should read before starting
